newsitem.title: USA: Missouri executes first of 4 prisoners in August.
newsitem.headline: Missouri executes first of 4 prisoners in August.

text.p: Convicted murderer Ralph Feltrop was killed by lethal injection early on Wednesday at a state prison in Potosi, Missouri, a prison spokesman said.
Feltrop, 42, was pronounced dead at 12:06 a.m. CDT (0506 GMT) after being jailed since August 1988. His was the first of four executions scheduled in Missouri this month.
He was convicted of first-degree murder June 29, 1988, in the death of his live-in girlfriend, Barbara Roam, on March 8, 1987. The couple lived in Jefferson County south of St. Louis.
The U.S. Supreme Court denied a motion for a stay of execution Tuesday evening and Governor Mel Carnahan denied Feltrop's appeal for executive clemency.
Feltrop, after eating a last meal of sirloin steak, french fries, cottage cheese with pinapple, a cheeseburger and a cocounut cream pie and a large pepsi, said before he died that he was innocent.
